defs.def: the way in which the parts of sth are connected together, arranged or organized; a particular arrangement of parts 结构；构造

ex.s: To explain the structure of a car.
This beautiful structure, named Glasshouse, is at the centre of a new garden that shows how the Silk Road influences English gardens even in modern times.
ex.t: 这座名为“玻璃屋”的美丽建筑位于一座新花园的中心，这座花园展示了丝绸之路即使在现代也依然影响着英式花园。

ex.s: The latest ____56____ (engineer) techniques are applied to create this protective ____57____ (function) structure that is also beautiful.
ex.t: 最新的____（工程）技术被用于打造这一兼具保护____（功能）与美观的结构。

ex.s: In cold weather, the structure stays ____59____ (close) to protect the plants.
ex.t: 寒冷天气时，这座结构保持____（关闭）状态以保护植物。

ex.s: Such structured thinking, followed by global regulation, will enable us to achieve greatness rather than our downfall.
ex.t: 这种有条理的思考，加上全球性的监管，将使我们成就伟大，而不是走向衰落。

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 虽然他坚持认为客观现实存在，但他说我们的心灵在构建和塑造我们的感知方面起着必要的作用。

ex.s: Their jaws were not conveniently structured.
ex.t: 他们的颌骨结构不方便。
因其复杂的结构而气馁。

defs.def: a thing that is made of several parts, especially a building 结构体；（尤指）建筑物

ex.s: Now look for more sentences with these structures in the reading passages.
ex.t: 现在在阅读文章中找出更多含有这些结构的句子。

ex.s: Do not go near any glass structures.
ex.t: 不要靠近任何玻璃建筑。

ex.s: Parallelism as a literary device is the use of expressions, clauses or sentences that are similar in their structure.
ex.t: 排比作为一种修辞手法，是指使用结构相似的表达、从句或句子。

ex.s: Learning activities homework exam Changes 1 the structure of your presentation 2 useful words, expressions and structures Write a reflection after completing this unit.
ex.t: 学习活动 作业 考试 变化 1 你展示的______结构 2 有用的词汇、表达和结构 完成本单元后写一份反思。

ex.s: Now look for more sentences with this structure in the reading passage, and summarise its use in your own words.
ex.t: 现在在阅读文章中找出更多含有这种结构的句子，并用自己的话总结其用法。

defs.def: the state of being well organized or planned with all the parts linked together; a careful plan 精心组织；周密安排；体系
